h1: Custom Golf T Shirts for Teams & Events
metaTitle: Custom Golf T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom golf t shirts for your next tournament or team event. Browse moisture-wicking styles and bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom golf t shirts offer a polished, sporty look for corporate outings, charity tournaments, and company golf leagues. Unlike standard tees, these shirts often feature moisture-wicking fabrics, three-button plackets, and UV protection to keep players comfortable on the course. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a crisp, professional finish that stands out from tee to green.
heroAltText: Custom golf t shirts with embroidered logo on a polo-style shirt, perfect for corporate golf events
